Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
An incredible holiday
For our last holiday, mum and I went to South Africa on safari—a tour where you go in a vehicle to see different animals. We started the experience by staying the night in a wooden house, where we met our safari guide, Mandisa. The house was by a lake and I was worried there might be fighting among the animals coming to drink. 16______ Mandisa explained that getting water was usually the most important thing for the animals when they were there. She also explained that although they looked relaxed, each one was always looking out for danger.
The next morning, we set off in a big car. There were six seats in the back, and the sides were open, so there were no windows. It made us feel closer to the animals. 17______ Mandisa was great at suggesting what would make good ones! She also taught us all about all the animals in the area.
Early in our drive, Mandisa pointed to a springbok. Springboks look like deer. She explained they are very common and are South Africa's national animal. 18______ Later, however, we saw some elephants under trees. After a while, the largest one tried trumpeting. Mandisa pointed out that there are certain types of behaviour to watch out for. 19______ She told us that because the elephant wasn't displaying any of the signs of this, we weren't in danger. Having Mandisa there explaining everything was really helpful.
We didn't just learn about different animals. There were special plants growing in the area too. Mandisa got us to try the leaves of one, to explain how they could provide salt. 20______ Mandisa told us that many animals get some of the salt they require from eating plants. All too soon, we had to leave. It was an experience I'll never forget!

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: Knowing which one helped us get the best view.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: Therefore, we realised we had to be patient.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: However, there wasn't and everything seemed very peaceful.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: This is something animals need to stay healthy.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: Despite this, we didn't see any more that day!

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: These can show when an animal is feeling stressed.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: As a result, animals quickly learn to avoid it.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: It was also good because it made it easier to take incredible pictures.

explanations.16: 作者担心动物争斗，C 选项 “However, there wasn't and everything seemed very peaceful.”（但一切平静）转折并描述实际情况，与 “Mandisa explained getting water was important” 衔接。
explanations.17: 敞篷车便于亲近动物，H 选项 “It was also good because it made it easier to take incredible pictures.”（也便于拍照）补充优势，与 “Mandisa suggested good photo spots” 呼应。
explanations.18: Springbok 常见，E 选项 “Despite this, we didn't see any more that day!”（但当天未再见到）转折并描述后续，与 “later saw elephants” 形成对比。
explanations.19: Mandisa 指出动物行为信号，F 选项 “These can show when an animal is feeling stressed.”（信号显示动物是否紧张）解释信号作用，与 “elephant wasn't displaying signs, not in danger” 衔接。
explanations.20: 尝试植物叶子获取盐分，D 选项 “This is something animals need to stay healthy.”（盐分是动物健康必需）说明意义，与 “many animals get salt from plants” 呼应。
